correctness.rationale: For Möbius ladder M_{2n}, n>=10, dihedral averaging of any l1 projection P onto ker B preserves range and norm convexity, so an invariant minimizer exists. If I-P=KB, then BK=I-J; the reflection-invariant flow h=K1_0, with chord g satisfying g_{n-i}=-g_i, parameterizes all invariant projections. The two edge-orbit column norms H and V are displayed sums of |a±g_i|, chord gradients and partial sums, so ||P||=max(H,V). A five-site signed coefficient certificate applied to 4H+V cancels every independent g variable after imposing antisymmetry, leaving 12-16/n, giving norm>=12/5-16/(5n). Two explicitly constructed rational g supports for 10<=n<=16 and n>=17 have H=V=12/5-16/(5n) and satisfy required inequalities, giving attainment. I independently expanded the dual signed functional symbolically with the correct reflection constraint and checked cancellation, then evaluated both exact-rational H,V constructions at n=10,11,12,16,17,31. A preliminary independent unconstrained-g check was intentionally corrected because these variables are not independent in the flow parameterization; no proof gap resulted. Infinite n conclusion relies on the exact symbolic coefficient pattern and regime inequalities, not a finite sample. Real field and ordinary edgewise l1 are essential.
